title: Cartwise Rewards Account Standing Quick Reference — Inactivity, Closure and Misuse Review
content:
Five settings govern the standing of a Cartwise Rewards account: how long it may go without an order, what happens to points when it closes, and how a misuse review treats it.

## Settings by tier

| Tier | Months without any order after which the account is closed | Target to finish a misuse review, in business days |
|---|---|---|
| Cartwise Rewards Member | 24 | 10 |
| Cartwise Rewards Bronze | 24 | 10 |
| Cartwise Rewards Silver | 24 | 10 |
| Cartwise Rewards Gold | 36 | 7 |
| Cartwise Rewards Platinum | 36 | 5 |
| Cartwise Rewards Diamond | 36 | 5 |

## Settings the same at every tier

| Setting | At every tier |
|---|---|
| Points lapse when the account closes | Yes |
| A misuse report suspends earning and redemption at once | Yes |
| Points held during a suspension post after the account is reinstated | Yes |

## Reading the table

- The inactivity figure counts months without any order: 24 months at Member, Bronze and Silver; 36 months at Gold, Platinum and Diamond.
- The review figure is a target counted in business days, not calendar days: 10 business days at Member, Bronze and Silver, 7 at Gold, and 5 at Platinum and Diamond.
- At no tier does a closed account keep its points; at every tier a misuse report stops earning and redemption straight away, and at every tier points held back during a suspension post once the account is reinstated.

## Hypothetical comparison

Two hypothetical accounts have each gone 30 months without an order: at Cartwise Rewards Silver that is past the 24-month figure, while at Cartwise Rewards Gold it is still short of the 36-month figure.
